description.value: Dovetail is a sophisticated Yaletown restaurant built around California-inspired, family-style shared plates and an elevated cocktail menu. The space channels a modern boho aesthetic informed by west coast seasonal produce, groovy house music, and an effortlessly chic energy. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a viable stop for cyclists riding through Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 96m; stands at 98m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates OSM name, address (1079 Mainland St, Vancouver Yaletown), phone (604.336.1088), and email. The site describes a California-inspired shared-plates restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating and an online ordering link ('ORDER' in nav), suggesting takeout is available. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM tag 'contact:facebook' points to an Instagram URL (instagram.com/dovetailvancouver) rather than a Facebook URL — likely a tagging error in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify at least bike parking or patio visibility before including.
